content: Open WebUI native web search wires SearXNG via env vars: ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH=True, WEB_SEARCH_ENGINE=searxng, SEARXNG_QUERY_URL=http://searxng:8080/search?q=<query>, WEB_SEARCH_RESULT_COUNT (default 3), WEB_SEARCH_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS (default 10). WEB_LOADER_ENGINE selects content extractor (playwright/firecrawl/tavily). Per-message toggle: user clicks Integrations button next to + icon to turn Web Search On/Off per session (resets on reload/chat-switch). Fetched pages embed via OWUI RAG; needs >=8192 ctx (16384 ideal). Full Context Mode feeds whole doc instead of vector retrieval. Citations via top-level sources field.
